CREATE SCHEMA cssql_oracle;

  CREATE TABLE cssql_oracle.analytics_boolean_origins (
    id integer PRIMARY KEY, tenant text NOT NULL, observed_at timestamp NOT NULL,
    channel text NOT NULL, score integer NOT NULL, region text, status text, flag boolean
  );

    (5,'A','2024-03-15','web',1,'A','incomplete',true),
    (6,'A','2024-03-15','web',1,NULL,NULL,false),
    (7,'B','2024-03-15','web',1,'A','incomplete',false),
    (8,'A','2024-02-15','web',1,'A','incomplete',false),

cases.query:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  analytics_boolean_origins.id AS "analytics_boolean_origins.id", MEASURE(analytics_boolean_origins.count) AS "analytics_boolean_origins.count"
  FROM analytics_boolean_origins
  WHERE (analytics_boolean_origins.observed_at >= '2024-03-01' AND analytics_boolean_origins.observed_at <= '2024-03-31') AND (analytics_boolean_origins.region = 'A' OR analytics_boolean_origins.status = 'completed') AND analytics_boolean_origins.web IS TRUE AND NOT(analytics_boolean_origins.flag = TRUE) AND analytics_boolean_origins.score >= 0
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  base."analytics_boolean_origins.id" AS "analytics_boolean_origins.id", base."analytics_boolean_origins.count" AS "analytics_boolean_origins.count"
  FROM base
  ORDER BY "analytics_boolean_origins.id"
  LIMIT 10

-- oracle:mc11_boolean_tree_truth
SELECT id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM cssql_oracle.analytics_boolean_origins
WHERE tenant = 'A' AND observed_at >= '2024-03-01' AND observed_at < '2024-04-01'
  AND channel = 'web' AND score >= 0
  AND (region = 'A' OR status = 'completed') AND NOT(flag = TRUE)
GROUP BY id ORDER BY id;
